what_it_does: This work studies how large language models fail during training on high-performance computing systems with graphics processing units. The researchers built LLMFI, a fault injection tool that simulates 300,000+ equipment failures to understand how transient faults (temporary hardware errors) affect LLM training differently than simpler deep learning tasks. They developed LLMFT, a machine learning-based fault tolerance framework that detects faults and recovers from them using dual recovery mechanisms.
